description: Construction number 61-240 and Block 10D; entered service 1981 at Nellis AFB Nevada; served with the 89th Tactical Fighter Squadron Air Force Reserve at Wright-Patterson AFB where it was named City of Akron in June 1991; to AMARC 28 July 1994 as FG0197 and still on inventory January 2008; recovered from Davis-Monthan and dedicated as a static display at the 180th Fighter Wing in 2015 or 2016 after a four to six week restoration; completes a four-jet fighter lineage row with the F-84F F-100D and A-7D; one published account gives the serial as 80-0159 which is a transposition; last confirmed July 2022
aliases: Block 10D; Fighting Falcon; Viper; c/n 61-240; F16; F16A
